If sentiment is negative (≤0.0) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to correct over-optimism.  
If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) and forecast peaks > 1.5% above recent high, cap forecast at 1.5% below recent high for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast shows sustained upward trend, reduce slope by 0.1–0.3% per day for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast dips below 70.0, add 0.2–0.5% upward bias for early horizon to avoid premature bottoming.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast exceeds 75.0, reduce by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to prevent overbought bias.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat or declining, add 0.1–0.3% upward bias for late horizon to avoid underestimating rebound potential.
